title: Star Office UI agent event, schema version 1 (ADR-035)
description: The envelope every agent posts to POST /events. Required fields, types and version=1 are enforced here; the instant itself is parsed and normalised to naive UTC by backend/event_schema.py, because jsonschema only honours 'format' when an optional format-checker is installed (SOU-36 ruling). Extra top-level fields are allowed on purpose: ADR-035 asks for forward compatibility, so an older backend must keep accepting clients that grow.

version.description: Schema version of this envelope. Only 1 exists; any other value is refused so a v2 client cannot silently write v1-shaped rows.

agent.description: Agent identifier, e.g. hermes, openchamber, opencode, pi, claude. Mapped to agents.id; the first event from an unknown agent registers an agents row. maxLength mirrors agents.name (String(255), migration 001).

event_type.description: Event type. Not a whitelist: ADR-035 wants new types (git_commit, api_call, web_scrape) to be addable without a schema change, so unknown values are stored as sent. maxLength mirrors events.event_type (String(100)).
event_type.$comment: Initial registry (non-normative): tool_call, state_change, file_edit, command_run, itsaplan_issue_transition, session_start, session_end.

timestamp.description: When the event happened, ISO 8601 (e.g. 2026-10-13T14:20:55.653Z). An offset is honoured and normalised to UTC; a naive value is taken as UTC. Enforced by the validator module, not by 'format' alone.

payload.description: Event-specific data, stored as JSON in full (JSONB on Postgres, TEXT on SQLite). Kept under the size cap backend/event_schema.py documents.
